obligation: FERPA
basis: The college receives funds under Department of Education programs through its Program Participation Agreement, so FERPA applies to its education records (34 CFR 99.1)

obligation: GLBA Safeguards Rule (Title IV institutions)
basis: Under its PPA the college agreed to comply with 16 CFR Part 314, which FSA enforces (Electronic Announcement GENERAL-23-09). It holds customer information on about 41,000 consumers, so the 314.6 exception for fewer than 5,000 consumers does not apply

obligation: COPPA Rule
basis: No online services are directed to children under 13; the minimum age at admission is 17

obligation: CIPA (E-Rate)
basis: The college receives no E-Rate discounts

obligation: HIPAA Security Rule
basis: The counseling and wellness center does not bill for services, so the college is not a covered entity. Counseling treatment records fall under the FERPA treatment records exclusion (34 CFR 99.3), and HIPAA excludes education records and those treatment records from protected health information (45 CFR 160.103)

obligation: CIRCIA (proposed)
basis: Not a final rule. The proposed rule would cover every Title IV institution regardless of size, so it is tracked

obligation: SAIG Enrollment Agreement: breach notice to FSA
basis: The college holds a SAIG Enrollment Agreement and uses SAIG for ISIRs and disbursement records

obligation: Title IV administrative capability: separation of duties and referral of fraud to the Office of Inspector General
basis: Title IV participant

obligation: Title IV record retention
basis: Title IV participant

obligation: Third-party servicer contracts
basis: A contracted servicer performs verification support and default prevention

obligation: Title IV credit balance refunds within 14 days
basis: The college pays about 9,000 credit balance refunds a year

obligation: Misrepresentation rules for Title IV institutions
basis: Title IV participant; the website and portal assistant speaks to prospective and current students

obligation: HEA limits on the use of FAFSA data
basis: The college receives ISIRs through SAIG

obligation: Clery Act emergency response and evacuation procedures
basis: The college publishes an annual security report; the emergency notification service depends on the identity provider and SIS contact data

obligation: Clery missing student notification
basis: No on-campus student housing

obligation: FTC Act Section 5 (unfair or deceptive practices)
basis: The college is a for-profit (proprietary) institution within FTC jurisdiction

obligation: Title VI, Title IX, Section 504 and the Age Discrimination Act
basis: The college receives federal financial assistance through Title IV

obligation: Federal contract clauses (FAR 52.204-21, -23, -25)
basis: No federal contracts or subcontracts

obligation: FAR Part 40 class deviation clause numbers (FAR 52.240-93 and 52.240-91)
basis: No federal contracts or subcontracts; recorded as background in the facts file and not scored

obligation: Controlled unclassified information and export-controlled research
basis: No sponsored research and no federal contracts

obligation: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
basis: Tuition card payments are taken on a vendor-hosted payment page and by the payment plan vendor

obligation: FSA encouragement to adopt NIST SP 800-171
basis: Guidance, not a requirement; tracked

obligation: Florida Information Protection Act (breach notification)
basis: The college holds personal information of Florida residents (campus students and about 1,925 online students)

obligation: Breach notification laws of other states
citation: Each state where affected individuals reside
basis: Online students live in 41 states

obligation: Colorado automated decision-making technology law
basis: About 110 online students live in Colorado; AI-001 and AI-005 influence decisions about applicants and students

obligation: California CPPA automated decision-making technology regulations
basis: About 240 online students live in California; whether the college is a CCPA business has not been determined

obligation: Employer partner agreements: availability commitment and SOC 2 Type 2 report
basis: 99.5% monthly portal availability and restoration within 24 hours; 2 hospital-system partners require a SOC 2 Type 2 report before their 2027-12-31 renewals

obligation: Cyber insurance policy notice conditions
basis: Notice through the carrier hotline is required before incident vendors are engaged
